name: hgi_coll_park_q1_bankrow_ref-bankrow3-COMMIT
purpose: Queue 1 own terminal congestion requirement remains active; apply measured bank-row structural topology with distinct QID source/mapped pins and fresh CTS. Actual prior local-clock route failed GRT-0116 with 12629 overflow at only 29.07% total usage: 10036/11774 report markers inside SRAM rectangles, 4434 zero-capacity interior markers; no standard-cell macro overlap in actual Q0 saved ODB. Transpose twelve actual SRAMs from four columns of three into four bank rows of three slices, keeping exact production FIFO depth512/width545, clock/reset/data epochs, actual libraries and full M5 PG/signal cap. This restores bank-local horizontal 545bit datapath corridors instead of cross-bank array crossings. Unassigned 395.28x302.4 prototype requires fresh measured timing/route and actual native slot/pin binding; no closure claim.
